mathematics.assertion_tested: Post-short-run declared continuation: short run had 30% error at t=160. Distinguish finite-time settling by extending to 640; do not loosen 10% tolerance.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: float64, radial finite volume with energy-adjoint gradient/divergence, velocity Verlet
mathematics.conventions: C=a0=Z=I=1. rho_b proportional exp(-r^2/8), cut at r=8, integral rho r^2 dr=1. Regular origin, fixed Phi=0 at outer face. No damping. Inverse CFG596 deficit interpolation as in previous nonlinear run.

criteria.formation: RMS fractional force error <=0.10 on r=2..20 at every sampled time 560..640; no negative force

controls: Discrete static solution has zero acceleration
Double outer radius at same resolution
Remove rho_b: zero initial state stays zero
non_claims: Fixed baryons, not coupled galaxy formation
No independent cold mass, metric/lensing or cosmology
No physical time unit or derived response coefficients
Finite-time approximate agreement is not an attractor theorem
